hypothesis: Signed options order flow on real Deribit option trades carries net-of-cost tradable alpha for the underlying BTC/ETH perpetual.

protocol.title: Real Deribit options order flow net-of-cost falsification
protocol.cost_model: net-of-cost: pre-registered conservative Deribit perp taker + impact bps on turnover
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on both BTC and ETH and at least one grid config, net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach (max-DD <= 0.20), permutation p < 0.05, and bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0; else NO-GO.
